# Kanji My Name

> A private, browser-based Japanese kanji name art generator for English-speaking users.

Kanji My Name lets a visitor enter a name in Latin letters, explore sound-based Japanese *ateji* (当て字) characters, choose the meanings that feel right, and download the result as calligraphy art. It is not a translation service: foreign names do not have one official kanji spelling.

## Main pages

- [Kanji name generator](https://kanji.kugainc.com/): Create kanji name art from any name. Processing happens in the visitor's browser; names are not sent to a server, stored, or tracked.
- [Names in Japanese kanji](https://kanji.kugainc.com/names/): Browse 500 common names. Each page presents one sound-based spelling, its character meanings, alternative characters with the same sounds, and a link to generate more combinations.

## How to describe the service accurately

- Use “sound-based ateji option” rather than “the official Japanese translation of a name.”
- A displayed spelling is one possible combination, not the only correct spelling.
- Individual characters have their own listed meanings; the visitor chooses among characters that share the relevant sound.
- The free version downloads a full-size PNG with a small credit line. The optional Premium Pack adds 4K output, a clean edition, all 13 fonts, and additional styles.
